name: Yellow Curry Corn Soup with Chickpeas, Broccoli & Shiitake [24-09-26] ✴️

ingredients.note: millet, dry weight as weighed - toasted and cooked separately in the IKEA 2 L
as weighed - a thin film for 407 g of onion

ingredients.ref: Thai Yellow Curry Paste (The SOS Kitchen)
ingredients.note: as weighed - dosed high, this jar is 824 mg sodium per 100 g, about a seventh of the Hollyfarms tom yum paste
as weighed - the citrus lift, without the acid that would grey the broccoli
frozen sweetcorn kernels - as weighed, the anchor the rest is scaled from
chickpeas counted at DRY weight - 250 g cooked the day before, less the ~7 g dry equivalent of the 15 g Anja ate. NEVER IN THE POT: served alongside for people to add at the bowl, like the millet
as weighed - well under the 417 g the scaling asked for
FRESH broccoli stems, peeled and sliced - as weighed. Generic raw-broccoli record, not the stalks record 169331, which carries no fibre at all
FRESH broccoli florets - as weighed, in after the stems, never blended
FRESH broccoli, a further 162 g added during the cook - form not recorded
the only shiitake in the dish - 25 g into the soup off the heat, 5 g into the millet water. Dried, so its guanylate is already formed and its enzymes are long dead
salt as actually added - 5 g into the soup at the finish, 2 g into the millet water, against the 13 g the design called for
